title: 覚醒維持義務と、不純な微睡
author: 灰原 ユキト

en.title: The Obligation of Wakefulness and the Impure Slumber
en.premise: In this city, to maximize productivity, citizens are bound by the "Duty of Constant Wakefulness." To prevent mental saturation, it is mandatory to sell off unnecessary memories and emotions in the "Memory Market" to secure brain capacity. A man working as a Memory Recovery Officer encounters a forbidden memory that has drifted into the market: a "longing for sleep." It is the beginning of a silent rebellion that will shake the very foundations of this controlled society.

zh.title: 觉醒维持义务与不纯的微睡
zh.premise: 在这座城市，为了实现生产力的最大化，市民被强制履行“觉醒维持义务”。为了防止精神饱和，市民必须在“记忆市场”出售多余的记忆与情感，以确保大脑容量。身为记忆回收官的男子，某天触碰到了流入市场的禁忌记忆——“对睡眠的憧憬”。那是动摇管理社会根基的、一场无声反叛的开端。
